name: dweb-video-studio
description: DVStudio (Dweb Video Studio) - Vite + Vue 3 + TypeScript + WebGL2 视频动画模板/编辑器，支持时间轴关键帧与 AI 对话辅助生成/修改场景。
author: DwebStudio

scripts.dev:web:all: concurrently -k -n vite,django -c blue,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:django"
scripts.dev:web:all:py3: concurrently -k -n vite,django -c blue,yellow "npm run dev:web" "python3 django-app/manage.py runserver 5800"
scripts.dev:backend:mac: if [ -x ../../.venv/bin/python ]; then ../../.venv/bin/python django-app/manage.py runserver 5800; elif [ -x ../.venv/bin/python ]; then ../.venv/bin/python django-app/manage.py runserver 5800; else python django-app/manage.py runserver 5800; fi
scripts.setup:django:mac: if [ -x ../../.venv/bin/python ]; then ../../.venv/bin/python django-app/manage.py migrate; elif [ -x ../.venv/bin/python ]; then ../.venv/bin/python django-app/manage.py migrate; else python django-app/manage.py migrate; fi
scripts.start:dev:mac: concurrently -k -n vite,django "npm run dev:vite:5173" "npm run dev:backend:mac"
scripts.dev:electron:app: npx --no-install wait-on --timeout 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env DWEB_RESOURCE_DIR=DVSResource ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173/ npx --no-install electron electron/main.mjs
scripts.dev:electron:app:empty: npx --no-install wait-on --timeout 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env DWEB_RESOURCE_DIR=DVSResource DWEB_SIMULATE_EMPTY_ENV=1 ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173/ npx --no-install electron electron/main.mjs
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "npx --no-install wait-on --timeout 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env DWEB_RESOURCE_DIR=DVSResource ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173/ npx --no-install electron electron/main.mjs"
scripts.dev:electron:empty: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "npx --no-install wait-on --timeout 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env DWEB_RESOURCE_DIR=DVSResource DWEB_SIMULATE_EMPTY_ENV=1 ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173/ npx --no-install electron electron/main.mjs"
